name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education

rules.quote: The girl candidate should be admitted to First year of Degree level course OR Second year of Degree level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE approved Institution
admitted to First year of Degree level course OR Second year of Degree level course through lateral entry
Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year.

rules.value: max two girl children per family
rules.quote: Maximum two girl child per family are eligible.
in any of the AICTE approved Institution of respective year

rules.value: gap after qualifying exam not more than 2 years
rules.quote: The gap period between the year of passing the qualifying examination and the session of admission in degree course should not be more than two years.
the student does not receive any financial assistance in shape of scholarship/any emoluments, salary, stipend etc. from any other source

rules.value: selection by merit of 10+2 marks, state-wise lists
rules.quote: on the basis of percentage of marks obtained in the 10+2/ equivalent examination

amount.text: Rs 50,000 per annum for every year of study (max 4 years; 3 for lateral entry)
amount.quote: Rs. 50,000/- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 4 years for first year admitted students and maximum 3 years for second year admitted students

documents.name: Income certificate issued by State/UT Government
documents.quote: A valid income certificate issued by State/ UT Government need to be enclosed.

documents.name: Passing certificate/marksheet for renewal
documents.quote: by submitting passing certificate/ marksheet along with letter from the Head of the Institution on the online portal

deadline.text: AICTE notification dated 19.06.2026: last date for online applications 31.10.2026; NSP lists student application close 31-10-2026
deadline.quote: has been opened & last date for submission of online applications is 31 .10.2026
